capabilities: Map multiple external folders to vault folders
Synchronize files one-way (import or export) or bidirectionally
Monitor external folders in real time and detect offline changes
Filter synced files by extension, subfolder, and filename glob patterns
Handle deletions via filename markers with ❌ prefix or complete removal
extras: README includes a data-loss disclaimer recommending regular backups before bidirectional sync, and warns of longer initial load times with large file sets. Developer contact section is empty.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep vault folders continuously synchronized with arbitrary folders elsewhere on disk, forcing users to copy files manually between their vault and other tools.
summary: Folder-sync plugin that keeps Vault folders and external folders synchronized in one or both directions, with real-time monitoring and file filters.
